apps.localizedDescription:
🎯 What is this?:

A port of the open-source IW4L engine to iOS. It does not contain the game: it reads the game files you already own on PC. Think of it as a new player for files you have.

📊 Where it stands:

• ✅ Runs natively on iPhone (Rust + Bevy + Metal).
• ✅ Reaches the main menu. Touch works as a click and a PS4 controller works.
• ✅ On an iPhone 17 Pro Max (6 GB granted to the app) full matches with bots run: watch the clip, by treuenten.

versions.localizedDescription:
Bo1ZPocket 0.3.46: download Bo1ZPocket.ipa below and install it over the app you have.

• Shooting feels instant: blood shows the frame you fire, gibs and deaths land a tick sooner, and the muzzle flash no longer stops after ~120 shots.
• Zombies die with BO1's own varied death animations, and bodies disappear a few seconds after they fall.
• Going down no longer makes the zombie on top of you spaz out; with Quick Revive they walk off as in BO1.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md.
